scope: All five remaining shared petal catalog virtual bodies plus complete orbit-index assignment (85) and petal component attachment (218).

limitations: Free/malloc/memcpy remain original shared dependencies through runtime.call(14/16/15).
All57 catalog virtual bodies being covered is a bounded petal-method result, not complete server/game recovery.
Tests cover complete catalog types and all three-instance missing/entity/component state combinations, but do not prove all arbitrary corrupt or overlapping-memory states.
The original C++ class layout names are inferred from catalog and dataflow roles; this is equivalent source, not a claim to recover original identifiers.

functions.name: deleteBehaviorObject

functions.name: assignPetalOrbitIndices
behavior: Visit all eight loadout slots, skipping type0/out-of-range and flag40 definitions.
Ungrouped instances receive consecutive indices; absent handles reserve configured positions, while entities without petal components do not.
Flag41 groups share a single index across up to three instances and advance once when any configured or present instance uses the position.
Write +292 when reaching the unlocked slot boundary selected by level byte +148 (5 below15,6 below30,7 below45,8 otherwise).
Preserve u8 truncation for index stores and all artifact load/store order within valid layouts.
